subject: Budget Feedback Survey Revisions
overview: The committee met to review, amend, and approve a public survey designed to gather resident feedback on Medford's municipal budget process. The revisions focused on clarifying budget visualizations, adding anonymous demographic questions, and expanding options to gauge public outreach preferences.

items.title: Municipal Budget Feedback Survey
items.summary: Approved the public budget feedback survey with amendments to incorporate an updated fixed-cost pie chart, anonymous household income brackets, and checkbox options regarding preferred methods for civic engagement.
